claim: DFW's uniform Use and Lease Agreement has a base term Oct 1, 2023 through Sep 30, 2033, with an April 2025 offer letter giving each Signatory Airline the option to extend to Sep 30, 2043; FY2034–2043 revenue sharing eliminates the Upper Threshold and splits net revenue 45% DFW / 55% Signatory Airlines.

page_or_section: Use and Lease Agreement structural summary
supporting_excerpt: DFW sets airline rates under a uniform Use and Lease Agreement with a base term October 1, 2023 through September 30, 2033, with an April 2025 offer letter giving each Signatory Airline the option to extend to September 30, 2043, and amending Fiscal Year 2034–2043 revenue sharing to eliminate the Upper Threshold and split net revenue 45% to DFW / 55% to the Signatory Airlines.

claim: Majority-in-Interest (MII) clauses at US airports typically require both a majority of signatory airlines by number and a majority of signatory airlines by activity to trigger a vote on capital additions funded through rates and charges.
source_title: Airline Use Agreement: Ratemaking & Negotiation
supporting_excerpt: An MII clause gives signatory airlines collective voting rights over specified airport decisions, most commonly capital improvement projects that will be funded through airline rates and charges. An MII vote typically requires both a majority of signatory airlines by number and a majority of signatory airlines by activity.
caveat: MII architecture varies airport-by-airport; DFW-specific MII thresholds are held in the confidential U&L and are not published.
